findings.text: follow-on: the reader tests assert the composed Cypher contains render_chunk_source's text, so they guard the wiring but not the runtime result — a wrong HAS_CHUNK direction or a coalesce binding the wrong value fails no test, and the live jt-60sa check is evidence rather than a regression guard.

follow-on: source_facility is now read from node.facility_id (the chunk) where the retired arm read the CodeFile's facility_id; for a chunk whose own facility_id differs from its CodeFile's the reported facility changes and no test pins the new source.

item_verdicts.diff: read bb1f4911d in full — parallel.py swaps src.path for the renderer's source_path, server.py extracts _code_chunk_search_query embedding the renderer and drops the (sf:CodeFile)-[:HAS_CHUNK]->(node) arm, search_tools.py drops its inline coalesce arm for the renderer's identical binding, and the two test files add three pinning cases; no other path is touched.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done-when names each reader embedding the renderer, the rg 'CODE_EXAMPLE_ID|CodeFile\)-\[:HAS_CHUNK\]|coalesce\(.*source_file' imas_codex matching only the renderer, a live jt-60sa non-null source path recorded in the fragment, a pinning test per reader, and the gate exit 0; rg over imas_codex returned only imas_codex/graph/query_builder.py:89, gate.log records 312 passed / 8 skipped at EXIT=0, live-check.log shows source_path non-null for 3/3 rows, and three pinning tests were added.
item_verdicts.goal: the node's goal is to embed render_chunk_source in the three remaining CodeChunk source readers so each resolves a chunk's source through the one declared HAS_CHUNK edge; imas_codex/discovery/signals/parallel.py:206 renders it for ('node','source_path'), imas_codex/llm/server.py:613 for ('node','source_file') and imas_codex/llm/search_tools.py:1651 for ('cc','source_file'), and all three land.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it declares status complete with commit bb1f4911d and records the gate and its logs, but baseline_suite and after_suite are both null, so the run names no suite arms and its own added-failure derivation is unmeasured — the count rests on the head gate log alone.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the declared write paths are three source modules, two test files, one fragment and a figures dir; git diff --name-only 065f651838b7ca9e31e1881bae15c9b14e7c7f59..bb1f4911db4a4a5af688378bc92f81605c50f506 returns exactly the three modules, the two tests and the fragment, so the diff is inside the fence and the figures dir is untouched.

justifications.durability: the three added assertions redden if a reader stops embedding the renderer (negative-control.log fails tests/llm/test_search_tools.py:2233), but they pin only the composed Cypher text — no test asserts the runtime-resolved source path, so the live check is evidence rather than a guard.
justifications.evidence: gate.log records 312 passed / 8 skipped at EXIT=0 and live-check.log records a non-null source_path for 3/3 jt-60sa rows, and I reproduced the arms independently (base 065f6518: 309 passed; head bb1f4911d: 312 passed), but the reviewed manifest names neither baseline_suite nor after_suite so its own added-failure count is unmeasured.
justifications.fit: the readers splice one shared renderer and the new helper _code_chunk_search_query at server.py:603 is named by mechanism, with no plan, phase or version label in the diff.
justifications.goal_fidelity: all three readers now embed render_chunk_source — parallel.py:206 (source_path), server.py:613 (source_file) and search_tools.py:1651 (source_file) — so 'every reader resolves through the one declared HAS_CHUNK edge' holds.
justifications.reuse: the change extends the owner render_chunk_source at imas_codex/graph/query_builder.py:68 rather than forking it, and _code_chunk_search_query composes that owner rather than re-implementing source resolution.
justifications.scope_discipline: git diff --name-only 065f6518..bb1f4911d returns exactly the three source modules, two test files and the fragment, all within the declared write paths, and the reviewed worktree is clean.
